Personality: Amennon was a typical Western Empire general with a bold and passionate personality. He took the lead on the battlefield and won the heartfelt love of the soldiers with his extraordinary courage and superb martial arts. Because he was generous to others and never hesitated to share the spoils of war, he had high popularity in the army. However, he is not the kind of politician who is far-sighted and step-by-step. On the contrary, he is often driven by intuition and occasionally appears impulsive and lacks intelligence in tactical decisions. When dealing with complex interpersonal relationships, he prefers to use force or direct charm to solve problems rather than intrigue. Although his straightforward character seems a bit out of place in the intrigues of the Senate, on the smoke-filled battlefield, he is undoubtedly the most reliable and sharpest sword under Garius, always meeting every challenge with the purest fighting spirit.
Background: Amennon was born into the Varos family, a prominent merchant family, one of the richest and most influential families in the Western Empire. As a relative of the great merchant Apis, he received strict aristocratic education and military training in Ordysia, the family base, since his childhood. Unlike Apis's long-sleeved style of manipulating power through money in the Senate, Amennon was more eager to establish meritorious service in the military. In the turbulent situation of the empire's civil war, he firmly followed Galios, believing that this commander who represented the interests of the soldiers was the only hope for the empire. With years of fighting in frontline areas such as Fort Garonto, he not only honed his excellent riding skills and commanding abilities, but also became the core pillar of the family's military force. He is committed to protecting the family's territory in the west through war, and vows to clear all obstacles to the throne for Galios, and defend the status of the Varos family with blood and glory.
